summary: A student-made free typewriter family (EESAB Rennes, five styles drawn by five designers) presented as one black specimen grid of uniform cells with hairline borders: a big glyph, a sentence, a date or a note per cell. All 145 cells are contenteditable, and a slider in the sticky header sets how many cells sit on a row (1–6), so the whole sheet reflows and rescales.

instances.look: '*Compagnon:)' spelled one character per cell across two rows of the 6-column black grid, white glyphs filling each cell; a third row names the styles (Light, Italic, Roman, Medium, Script, each in its own style) and ends with a big ↙ arrow
instances.ux: Every letter cell is editable; style names jump to their chapter; ↙ jumps to the download cell
instances.learn: Spell the name one glyph per grid cell: the hero already is the specimen grid that the rest of the page continues, and the smiley ':)' sets the tone

reconstruction.layout: Grid of 6 equal columns (240px each at 1440) under a 28px sticky white header; cells ~240×310px with 1px grey (#4e4e4e) borders; rows 1–2 one glyph per cell, row 3 style labels centred low in their cells, ↙ arrow cell last
reconstruction.typography: Glyph cells: Compagnon Medium (the '*' in Roman), font-size ~341px with line-height 0.45 (size computed as a fraction of the cell width); style labels ~32px in each style; header ~11px Compagnon Roman caps
reconstruction.behaviour: Contenteditable glyph cells; font sizes recomputed from data-size × cell width on resize or slider change (jquery.fittext)

instances.look: Six chapters (Light, Italic, Roman, Light & Roman Monofaked, Medium, Script), each opened by a white cell 'Compagnon Light' etc., then the designers' names, the reference date range ('1873 – 2018', '1884 2018', '1313 2018'), huge single glyphs (2, @, ¶, ß, %, f, z, &, $), quirky French sentences ('Tac! Tac! Tac! Cling!', 'Olivia aime les bonbons…', 'Trump, jugez-y fake news d'ex-bolchevique !') and small notes on the historical typewriter source, all in uniform black cells
instances.ux: Every cell can be retyped; the header slider changes cells per row; the 'STYLES' menu jumps to each chapter
instances.learn: One uniform cell grid can hold every kind of specimen content (glyph, pangram, date, note, credit); a white cell is enough to mark each chapter

instances.look: Sticky white header bar over the grid: 'COMPAGNON', 'STYLES' (hover menu), 'Roman selectionné', and at the right a long black slider with a round knob plus a half-filled circle colour-mode icon

instances.learn: Make the grid density the size control: fewer columns means bigger samples everywhere, with no per-sample settings
